Title: Announcing extended term reservation for the Azure HBv2 Virtual Machine

Body.Content:
Announcing the availability of the 5-year reservation for the Azure HBv2 Virtual Machine.  The extended term reservation provides significant cost discount compared to pay-as-you-go rates.

The extended term reservation provides continuous access to HBv2 resources for all supported Azure regions. All offer terms and conditions, with a few exceptions, are the same as other Azure Reserved VM Instances.
